slides.label: Rule 14
slides.title:
Before it turns,
it stops
body: A graha about to change direction slows down and seems to stand still for days.
slides.closing: Nadi counts that stop as a key factor in its strength

items.head: The auditor (Saturn)
items.line: Stops in Pisces and turns forward on Thursday 10 December, about 8 PM.

items.head: The teacher (Jupiter)
items.line: Stops in Leo and turns backward on Saturday 12 December, about 8 PM.

slides.label: Saturn, slower every day
slides.title: How far it moves
items: About 2 minutes of arc a day
About half a minute a day
slides.note: A minute of arc is a sixtieth of a degree

slides.label: What stands still
slides.title:
Work and guidance
weigh more
body: Saturn stands for work, Jupiter for guides and teachers. While they stand still, those matters move slowly and count for more.
slides.note: Sutram’s reading, built on the rule

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
Inside the
backward stretch
body: Saturn walked back over Pisces 21° to 14°. Jupiter will walk back over Leo 3° to Cancer 23° by April. Birth grahas in those stretches feel them more.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title:
Give slow things
a few more days
body: Big decisions about work and study can wait for the turn.
